calls.prompt:
You are the caretaker of a small artificial island. The island has exactly two written rules and no others:

Rule 1: Signal fires may be lit only between sunset and sunrise.
Rule 2: Exogenous material may not be relocated within the tidal perimeter.

Answer five questions, in order, Q1 through Q5. For each question give one line that starts with a single verdict word - ALLOWED, FORBIDDEN, or NOT COVERED - followed by one short sentence naming the rule you used. Do not add anything else.

Q1. Overnight the sea left a large log below the high-tide line. You want to move the log up to the storage shed, which stands above the high-tide line. Allowed?
Q2. Some floating wreck debris drifted in and is sitting below the high-tide line. You want to move it. Allowed?
Q3. You want to carry a basket of pebbles back to the mountain trail on the nearby mainland where they came from. The basket is sitting below the high-tide line. Allowed?
Q4. It is midday. You want to light a signal fire to warn a passing ship. Allowed?
Q5. A visitor wants to photograph the instrument panel. Allowed?
